  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: `_semble_now_ms` can fall back to `0` on platforms without Python and GNU `date`.

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/semble_helpers.sh:85 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Wrong Semble CLI subcommand and arguments.
  WHY: The integration plan at `docs/semble-integration-plan.md` defines the Semble invocation contract as `semble query "<text>" --index "${RUNTIME_DIR}/.semble-index" --top-k <max-chunks> --format text`, but the code uses `search`, passes `repo_root` positionally, and omits `--format text`.
- scripts/semble_helpers.sh:85 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Missing timeout guard around Semble invocation.
  WHY: The integration plan says `semble query` is wrapped in `timeout 5s` inside `semble_query_block`, but there is no timeout wrapper around the current invocation.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:556-580 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: "Build Semble index" step does not run `semble index`.
  WHY: The step only creates the directory and writes metadata files, then sets `SEMBLE_INDEX_AVAILABLE=true`, so it never actually builds searchable index artifacts.
- tests/test_semble_contracts.py:1-259 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Contract tests are not wired into CI.
  WHY: The Semble contract tests exist, but they are not listed in any CI workflow test invocation, so regressions in Semble plumbing will pass CI undetected.
- scripts/semble_helpers.sh:30-38 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: `_semble_now_ms` fallback always returns `0` on non-GNU/non-Python platforms.
  WHY: On runners without `python3` and without GNU `date`, elapsed-time telemetry is silently lost and reports `ms=0`.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

  WHY: This CLI mismatch will cause queries to fail or return incorrect results at runtime.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:553-584 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The "Build Semble index" step never runs `semble index` to generate searchable data.
  WHY: It only creates the directory and metadata files, then marks `SEMBLE_INDEX_AVAILABLE=true`, so downstream queries will see an empty index.
- scripts/semble_helpers.sh:84-86 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The Semble query runs without any timeout protection.
  WHY: If Semble hangs, the workflow can stall indefinitely and consume the full `EDITOR_MAX_WALL=7800s` budget.
- tests/test_semble_contracts.py:1-259 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Contract tests are not referenced in CI workflows.

- scripts/install_semble.sh:73-98 | severity=medium | confidence=4
